verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right order (bag, then CITRINE and headline, then CTA), but the two big brand circles have been shrunk to tiny stray dots, and the green one is clipped at the top edge, so they read as specks rather than the design's motif. Its CTA is small and pushed close to the right edge. B keeps the circles at a meaningful size, layered behind the bag and the button, so it is closer to the original's feel. However, its oversized CTA pill competes with the headline, the headline nearly touches the button, CITRINE is jammed against the headline, and the bag sits close to the left edge.
